I've been using the brown sugar and it's really helping my lips. The oils keep my lips moist. I have a lip piercing that makes it a bit difficult to keep my lips exfoliated, so I bought these scrubs to help with that.  They smell great, and they taste wonderful too. They're a perfect consistency to scoop out and spread across my lips- not dry or sticky at all. I always feel so much better after I use them, and my lips are definitely benefitting from using these once in a while!

Smells wonderful and the ingredient list looks fab. Was more soft and insubstantial than I was expecting. I’ve only had one other lip exfoliater and I thought it worked much better than these. But they are yummy and cute. It’s so dry here in winter it’s hard to deal with chapped lips. Unfortunately these didn’t help much at all even with frequent use.

I really like these and i like how it also moisturizes my lips after a lip scrub. I have tried other lip scrubs and none of them compare to Eco lips. I would recommend this product and its so gentle on the lips. They are really small so its convenient to just stick in your make up bag and travel with.

Could not possible love this anymore! It's the best lip scrub I've been tired! I like it so much more than the one I got from Lush. It's so much more hydrating and they smell amazing! I'll definitely by more whenever I run out!

I have never used a lip scrub before so this is the first time ever with this product. Let me tell you the smells are amazing! It tasted delicious on my lips too and it left them so moisturized it was unreal!

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for!
reviews.x: Love these little pots of lip exfoliating joy.  Easy to use and wipe off. Dead skin on lips just slides off.  Don’t particularly like the vanilla flavor, overly sweet but the others are fine. Would reorder.
I love this stuff! Comes in these little jars (but don't worry, plenty of lip balm in each) the 4 flavors are great. Will use them and when the time comes will send them out as gifts to friends.
The product smells wonderful a very reasonable price it works wonderfully and I like that I have the option to lick the rest of it off or I can wipe it off I definitely will order this again
We used these for a spa night for 18 girls and moms.  All flavors got good reviews (especially brown sugar!) except vanilla.  Everyone who tried it said it tasted nasty.
Love it, I wish it came in a glass jar but I bought it knowing it didn’t.  Bought this as part of my gift for my bridesmaids & everyone seemed to enjoy it as well.
I haven't tried the other three yet but vanilla bean tastes like chapstick. Despite that,  it does an excellent job of exfoliating and moisturizing my lips.
I've never heard of this before, I tried it & it work better than any other products I've ever tried. It goes on easy, moisturizes great, & tastes good!!
I have purchased these a few times and always get compliments from the gift recipient. Great for stocking stuffers, teacher gifts or for yourself.
These are great little scrubbing and moisturizing lip balms, that are edible (can lick off the sugar afterward) and actually healthy ingredients.
My lips were smoother after using product. I have tried the brown sugar and mint so far and not disappointed. Nice to have good taste.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the scrub leaves their lips soft and moisturized, often working better than other scrubs they've tried.
Reviewers frequently praise the flavors and scents, calling them great, yummy, and amazing.
Some reviewers find the product too greasy or thin, with sugar that melts too quickly to scrub effectively.
Several reviewers note the containers are very small, though some find this convenient for travel or gift baskets.
A few reviewers mention the product helps with dry, cracked, peeling lips, especially in cold winter weather.
